item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 03/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the coast of western Guangdong and Beibu Wan, and continue to weaken today and tomorrow. Showers will lessen over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Haikui over the seas east of Taiwan will move across Taiwan today and tomorrow, and then towards the vicinity of the coast of eastern Guangdong to southern Fujian, but its movement remains uncertain. Showers associated with Haikui will affect the vicinity of the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. A continental airstream is expected to bring generally fine weather to southern China in the latter part of this week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few squally showers and thunderstorms. Sunny intervals during the day. There will be swells.
Temp range: 26 - 32 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
